title: Add RAG scenario fork & replay CLI playbook
author: Sofia Ramirez
description:
This PR introduces a lightweight CLI playbook for authoring, forking and deterministically replaying RAG scenarios locally. Motivation: teams iterating on retrieval-augmented agents often need a small, reproducible surface to branch scenario state, inject deterministic seeds, capture step-level traces and replay flows for QA and evals. The playbook bundles: 1) rag-scenario-fork CLI: snapshot current session state to a portable scenario bundle, create forks (branching) for variant testing, and attach seed + env metadata; 2) rag-replay CLI: deterministic replay of a scenario with configurable overrides (model variant, prompt presets, tool stubs) and replay probes that emit structured step traces for telemetry; 3) a set of example scenarios (3 canonical flows) and an authoring README with authoring tips, assertions and guidance for adding new scenarios; 4) minimal E2E smoke tests + GitHub Actions job to run replay smoke tests on PRs. Checklist:
- [x] CLI commands implemented in TypeScript + compact bin wrapper
- [x] Playbook README with step-by-step authoring guide and migration notes
- [x] Example scenarios (search, multi-tool compose, long-form QA)
- [x] Replay probes output in newline-delimited JSON for easy ingestion by existing telemetry tools
- [x] CI workflow for quickstarts that runs smoke replays on node 18
- [x] Docs index entry added to quickstarts landing

Motivating use-cases: iterative authoring for product teams, deterministic regression tests for model/toolchain upgrades, QA reproducible seeds when triaging flakiness. Related: ENG-11567 (replay hooks), PR #52789 (embeddings-first browser playbook) inspired the format for scenario bundles. How to try locally: see quickstarts/rag-scenario-fork/README.md — short commands included. No infra changes required for hosted deployments; everything runs locally or in CI as a smoke check.

Notes on scope: this is intentionally small and self-contained — the goal is to provide a low-friction authoring loop rather than a full orchestration product. Future follow-ups (tracked in ENG-12034) will add browser-based UI and a metrics exporter plugin.
commit_summary: Add CLI bin for rag-scenario-fork and rag-replay; add three example scenarios; docs and CI smoke tests; small refactors for scenario bundle format
